name: ElectraFix — Electrical Equipment Repair

source.readFrom: Extracted tokens + section structure from the Home Page frame (visual not captured; section layouts inferred from the frame tree).

character: Bold, industrial TRADES / REPAIR / automotive look. Condensed all-caps display type, high-contrast near-black + white, a strong red primary with an orange secondary. Reads confident, hands-on and dependable. Best for electricians, mechanics, HVAC, repair shops, construction, equipment and industrial-service businesses.

typography.notes: The condensed ALL-CAPS Bebas Neue display over calm Inter body is the signature contrast — big, punchy headings, quiet readable text. A serif or a soft rounded font would break the industrial feel.

color.notes: High-contrast near-black on white, a bold RED primary (CTAs, key headings, accents) with an ORANGE secondary for support. Dark near-black sections for contrast. REUSE the high-contrast + bold-warm-accent structure; put the lead's brand colour in the red slot (this system suits warm/bold brands; for a soft/pastel brand pick a calmer system).

spacing.notes: Firm ~60–80px sections, 24px content gaps. Content on a ~1200px column in a 1440 frame.

button.shape: Rectangular or slightly-rounded, solid red primary; outline/ghost secondary.
button.notes: High-contrast, confident CTAs; often ALL-CAPS label.

card.shape: White or dark card, thin border or flat, square-ish corners.

sectionLayouts.note: Inferred from the frame structure (12 full-height sections). Reuse the industrial-service archetypes below; swap in the lead's brand + real photos.

order.layout: Logo left, nav + a bold CTA right; dark or white bar.
Big ALL-CAPS condensed headline + short lead + red CTA, with a strong equipment/work photo (often near-full-bleed or split).
Section heading + a row/grid of service cards (icon or photo → title → short copy).
Text + supporting image; bold stat or promise callouts.
A row of big numbers (jobs done, years, response time).
Numbered steps of how the service works.
A grid of real job/equipment photos (before/after or portfolio).
Bold red band: big heading + phone/booking CTA.
Dark footer: contact details, hours, service area, links.

reusableArchetypes: ALL-CAPS condensed hero with a strong equipment photo
craftNotes: Condensed ALL-CAPS headings + high contrast do the heavy lifting — keep body calm.
Use the lead's REAL equipment/work photos prominently (this niche sells on proof).
Red primary for action, near-black/white for everything else.

reuse: Use for trades / repair / mechanic / HVAC / electrician / construction / industrial-service leads. Take the Bebas-Neue-ALL-CAPS + Inter pairing, high-contrast palette with a bold warm accent, and the service/stats/process/gallery archetypes. Put the lead's brand colour in the red slot and use their real work photos.
